Slow: Whenever you play a card, this enemy receives 10% more damage from Attacks this turn.
Territorial: At the end of its turn, gains X Strength.
Plow: The first time this enemy's HP reaches X or below, it becomes Stunned and loses all its Strength.
Ringing: You can only play 1 card this turn.
Minion: Minions abandon combat without their leader.
Slippery: The next X times it loses HP, it only loses 1 HP instead.
Hardened Shell: It cannot lose more than X HP each turn.
Skittish: The first time it is hit each turn, it gains X Block.
Shriek: The first time this enemy's HP reaches X or below, it becomes Stunned.
Steam Eruption: When killed, deals X damage at the end of your next turn.
Beckon:
At the end of your turn, if this is in your Hand,
lose 6 HP.
Vulnerable: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for X turns.
Intangible: Reduce all damage taken and HP loss to 1. Lasts for X turns.
Plating: At the end of your turn, gain X Block. Plating is reduced by 1 at the start of your turn.
Asleep: Awakens upon losing HP or after X turns.
Reattach: If other segments are still alive, revives in 2 turns with X HP.
Personal Hive: Whenever this enemy is hit by an Attack, add X Dazed into your Draw Pile.
Tainted: Take X additional damage from Attacks this turn.
Sandpit: In X turns, you will be eaten and die.
Disintegration: At the end of your turn, take X damage.
Mind Rot: Draw X fewer cards each turn.
Sloth: You cannot play more than X cards each turn.
Waste Away: Gain X less Energy per turn.
Back Attack: Deals 50% more damage when it is attacking you from behind.
Crab Rage: When an ally dies, it gains 6 Strength and 99 Block.
Hex: While Spectral Knight is alive, ALL your cards are Ethereal.
Dampen: While Magi Knight is alive, ALL your cards are Downgraded.
Chains of Binding: The first X cards drawn each turn are Afflicted with Bound.
Adaptable: When it would be defeated, it instead revives even stronger.
Enrage: Whenever you play a Skill, gains X Strength.
Withering Presence: Every 6 cards you play, add a Wither to your Hand.
